audit.why: win[] reads Yorick, Yorick, Skill, Skill, Skill, Master Yi, Yorick and matches the packet chart exactly, with whys that argue each row. There is no full layer on this matchup at all, so there is no sides/win pair to disagree — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spikes were named by feel — 'until he spikes', 'he now bursts past your ghouls' — with no ability or timing behind either one.
audit.why: His level-6 spike is Highlander: 85s, and it makes him IMMUNE TO SLOWS, which is precisely what Mourning Mist is. His first-item spike is Wuju Style, a 14s window of true damage on basic attacks, so no amount of armour changes that trade. Yorick's spikes are levels 1-2 with the swarm and the two-item Maiden grind.
audit.corrected: Highlander's 85s and slow immunity into whys[4] and spikes[1]; Wuju Style's true damage into whys[5] and spikes[2].
sources: enemyKit R cd 85, 'immune to all slowing effects'

audit.whatIsWrong: Flagged defect — no cooldown sequencing anywhere. Alpha Strike is called 'his single Alpha Strike' with no cooldown and no mention that he is untargetable during it, and Meditate is never described as an interruptible channel.
audit.why: Alpha Strike is 20s at rank 1 — enormous for a laning ability — and his basic attacks shorten it, so the timer is really an attack count. He is untargetable during the strike, so burst timed onto it is wasted. Meditate is a 10s channel that heals and reduces damage taken, and Riot's channel flag means any CC cancels it: Yorick has no hard CC, so this is the moment to call a jungler. It is also the sustain Grievous Wounds answers.
audit.corrected: Alpha Strike's 20s and untargetability into spikes[0] and whys[2]; Meditate's channel into early; Grievous Wounds into late.
sources: enemyKit Q cd 20/19.5/19/18.5/18, untargetable, 'Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown'
